landing_general__hero_description: Photos, videos, voice notes and written wishes — gathered from everyone at your event and saved to one beautiful dashboard, live.
landing_general__product_title: Built to capture the whole event
landing_general__product_description: Everything your guests send flows into one live dashboard — organized, backed up, and ready to keep.
landing_general__dashboard_description: Every photo and message appears the moment a guest hits send. No app to manage, nothing to chase down after the event.
landing_general__phone_description: Guests scan a QR code and instantly add photos, record a voice note or write a wish, right from their own phone.
landing_general__phone_bullet_1: Works on any phone, no download
landing_general__phone_bullet_2: Photos, video, voice & text in one flow
landing_general__phone_bullet_3: Or run Kiosk mode on a tablet
landing_general__flows_description: One for your guests, one for you. Both take minutes — and everything connects automatically.
landing_general__guest_flow_step1_descri: A guest points their camera at the QR code on the table — no app to install.
landing_general__guest_flow_step2_descri: Upload photos & video, record a voice message, or leave a written wish.
landing_general__guest_flow_step3_descri: Their memory lands in the host's dashboard live, organized automatically.
landing_general__host_flow_step1_descrip: Name it, set the date, pick a cover — live in minutes.
landing_general__host_flow_step2_descrip: Print QR codes for every table, or run Kiosk mode on a tablet.
landing_general__host_flow_step3_descrip: Every photo, voice and note streams into your dashboard as it arrives.
landing_general__host_flow_step4_descrip: Turn your favorites into a premium hardcover Gold Book.
landing_general__collect_title: Every kind of memory, in one place
landing_general__collect_photos_body: Unlimited uploads from every guest, gathered into one shared gallery automatically.
landing_general__collect_voice_body: Heartfelt voice messages recorded on the spot and saved beside every memory.
landing_general__collect_written_body: Written notes and guestbook messages, kept together in your timeline forever.
landing_general__keepsake_title_line1: A hardcover book, made from your
landing_general__keepsake_description: Drag in your favorites and Ovation lays out a premium hardcover — with guests' voices printed as a scannable code on the page.
landing_general__final_cta_description: Set it up in minutes. Invite everyone with a scan. Keep the memories forever.
